mars.fireText: Mars = anger fire (क्रोध अग्नि) — keep-going physical aggression. Ketu = sadhana fire (साधना अग्नि) — past-life spiritual heat. Ketu detaches; Mars starts anew. Both fiery → lifelong अंतर्द्वंद when conjunct. BPHS: Ketu as ध्वज रूप (tall flag, unstable sway); Mars as क्रूर कर्मा yet शक्ति युक्त.
